# geo_turf v0.4.0 - Table of Contents

A spatial analysis tool for Elixir's [Geo](https://github.com/bryanjos/geo) library ported from [TurfJS](http://turfjs.org/).

## Pages

- [Geo Turf Changelog](https://geo-turf.hexdocs.pm/changelog.md)

## Modules

- [Geo.Turf](https://geo-turf.hexdocs.pm/Geo.Turf.md): # Geo.Turf
- [Geo.Turf.Classification](https://geo-turf.hexdocs.pm/Geo.Turf.Classification.md): A collection of classification and boolean spatial functions.

- [Geo.Turf.Helpers](https://geo-turf.hexdocs.pm/Geo.Turf.Helpers.md): A collection of helper utilities.
Usually users will not have to refer to this directly but it is here
if the need arises.

- [Geo.Turf.Math](https://geo-turf.hexdocs.pm/Geo.Turf.Math.md): All sorts of mathematical functions

- [Geo.Turf.Measure](https://geo-turf.hexdocs.pm/Geo.Turf.Measure.md): A collection of measurement related tools

- [Geo.Turf.Transformation](https://geo-turf.hexdocs.pm/Geo.Turf.Transformation.md): A collection of functions to transform given geometries
